title: Refill Volume Days — Footnote to the Vacation Release Schedule
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, vacation releases.** The refill count days reward steady refill activity on the member's pharmacy coverage.

**Rule.** The refill count days are three (3) where the coverage carries six (6) or more paid refills of any drug in the last three months, two (2) where it carries three (3) to five, and nothing otherwise.

The refills counted are the paid fills on the member's pharmacy coverage that are refills, of any drug, with a fill date in the last three months. The refill count days are added to the vacation release days once the days on hand have been taken off the plan's most extra days supply; the release that results is never fewer than one day and never more than the plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases.

| Paid refills of any drug on the coverage, last three months | Refill count days |
|---|---|
| Six or more | 3 |
| Three, four or five | 2 |
| Two or fewer | Nothing |

*Example (hypothetical):* five paid refills across three drugs in the last three months give 2 days; a sixth paid refill in the window raises it to 3.
